Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Mandalore the Avenger]] formed a '''crew''' of specialized mercenaries to [[Malgus's escape|liberate]] [[Darth Malgus]] from [[Carrick Station]]. After Shae Vizla breached the prison where Darth Malgus was held,<ref name="Sundering" /> Vizla and her crew [[Attack on a Hidden Chain base|attacked]] a [[Hidden Chain]] base on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Galactic Threads">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Galactic Threads|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Following the attack, the crew took a Hidden Chain [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and navigated to [[Khar Shian]],<ref name="Last Road to Khar Shian">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20260528|text="Last Road to Khar Shian"|int=Last Road to Khar Shian}}</ref> a forgotten [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] which housed the abandoned [[Naga Sadow's fortress|fortress]] of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]. As they arrived on the moon, Darth Malgus betrayed Vizla and her crew, declaring that [[Heta Kol]], the [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] of the Hidden Chain, was not his concern. Malgus exited the crew's shuttle mid-flight, abandoning the crew to pursue on his own within the fortress.<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>
